data.name: Unemit
data.description: Unemit is a Berkeley, California-based Direct Air Capture startup backed by Breakthrough Energy Fellows and led by MIT-trained engineer Christian Haakonsen. The company is developing a modular DAC contactor system that uses a chemical sorbent regenerated with low-temperature heat, aiming to scale to gigaton-level atmospheric CO2 removal.
